_doc: The hourly clock (WAVE3.md §1; owner decision 1, 5 Oct). Minutes of the hour (mm:ss). NEWS IN 60 at :00 and :30 is FIXED: the station lands it within `tolerance` seconds (short breaks when early). Any other slot is skipped when the channel runs more than `lateSkip` seconds behind it. A `rotate` slot gives each programme of its list its turn, hour by hour. `hours` [from, to) and `days` (0 Sunday) limit a slot. Set "clock": false (or CLOCK=off) for the plain rotation of channel.json. Any programme of channel.json may fill a slot, news or not.
